# MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

Scope
- This document prescribes fastener inspection and torque verification for EQ-P2-L4-HT02. Use this procedure between scheduled maintenance activities and after any intervention that disturbs fastened joints. Refer to MM-P2-L4-HT02 and SOP-P2-L4-01 for overarching maintenance planning and to SOP-P2-L4-04 for lockout/tagout requirements.

Tools
- Calibrated hand torque wrench suitable for specified torque values (use manufacturer or referenced documentation for target values).  
- Quick-reference fastener checklist.  
- Inspection mirror and flashlight.  
- Clean lint-free rags and solvent approved by maintenance.  
- Lubricant: CFW-LUB-426.

Procedure
- Prepare: Verify LOTO per SOP-P2-L4-04 and confirm scope with maintenance planner per MM-P2-L4-HT02.  
- Visual inspection: Inspect all exposed fasteners for corrosion, thread damage, washers condition, and evidence of movement or fretting. Document findings on the checklist.  
- Clean and prepare: Remove debris and old lubricant from mating surfaces using approved solvent. Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-426 where specified by the fastener manufacturer or referenced documentation.  
- Torque sequence: Follow the torque sequence and values provided in the equipment manufacturer documentation or MM-P2-L4-HT02. Use a calibrated torque wrench and apply torque in consistent increments until final values are achieved. If any fastener does not achieve required torque, document and replace the fastener per MM-P2-L4-HT02.  
- Special note: Do not operate EQ-P2-L4-HT02 until fastener condition is verified and documented. Observe quench system guidance; the quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 10 seconds.

Acceptance criteria
- All inspected fasteners show no visual defects and meet the specified torque values per MM-P2-L4-HT02.  
- Lubricant applied where required: CFW-LUB-426 documented.  
- Checklist completed and signed; any deviations routed to maintenance planner and recorded per SOP-P2-L4-01.
